feedback: The candidate changes only the controller: kp 6.0 to 7.0 and kd 0.3 to 0.4, with geometry, base_speed 1.4, ki 0.05 and last_direction unchanged from iteration 2. The rationale matches the evidence. Iteration 2 (16 mm sensors at x = ±0.030 m, kp 6.0, kd 0.3) ran off track on all 60 trials, with line_loss_events down from 2 to 1 per run, max_error 0.061 to 0.063, steering_oscillation 0.14 to 0.17 and progress 0.31 (oval), 0.16 (s-bend) and 0.11 (slalom). Oscillation is well below the 0.2 concern, so raising kp is the justified next step, and the change isolates one variable. This is an early iteration with 8 left after this one, and a raced result is more useful than further desk review, so approve. Nothing here states how this candidate will perform. After the race, use the telemetry as follows. If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.2, raise kd to 0.5 before cutting kp, as the rationale says. If max_error stays at or above 0.06 while oscillation is low, widen the array to ±0.040 m with 16 mm sensors and test kp near 8. If line_loss_events stay at 1 per run at the same bend entries, test line_loss search_right or search_left, choosing the side the failing bends favour. If progress is still below 1 while max_error is under 0.06, raise base_speed toward 1.6.
requested_changes: After the race: if steering_oscillation rises above about 0.2 with kp 7.0, raise controller.kd to 0.5 before lowering kp, because iteration 2 showed low oscillation (0.14 to 0.17) at kp 6.0 and the widened array raises effective gain.

After the race: if max_error stays at or above 0.06 with oscillation low, widen geometry.sensor_positions to x = ±0.040 m and try kp near 8.0, since iteration 2 cut line losses from 2 to 1 per run but max_error moved only from about 0.068 to 0.063.

After the race: if line_loss_events stay at 1 per run at the same bend entries, change controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_right or search_left, and if progress is still below 1 with max_error under 0.06, raise controller.base_speed toward 1.6.
